services.desc: If you are looking for a Pacific Northwest experience unlike any other, you’ve found it! Hop on board our semi-covered boat to search for whales, porpoises, sea lions, eagles, and more as we take in breathtaking views of the San Juan Islands and surrounding waters. We’ll stop in the beautiful town of Friday Harbor on San Juan Island where you’ll be able to shop, dine, or explore! While we can’t make any promises when it comes to finding wildlife - given that they truly are wild animals roaming free - we take pride in our tremendously high sightings rates that are among the highest in the whale watching community. Two boats are used: a zodiac-style vessel for up to 17 passengers and a semi-covered boat for up to 6 guests.
